content.text: {"answer":"10%","citations":["D041","D082","D065"],"explanation":"The signed Renewal Order Form (D041) took effect 2026-04-01 and applies a 10% discount, giving USD 1,728 per seat per year, so it governs on 2026-05-01. The 12% in the 2026-04-09 meeting note (D082) is an informal recap that conflicts with the signed contract, and the 12% in D065 applied only until renewal talks, which D041 superseded."}
